tools.name: apply_preset
tools.description: Apply a develop preset (ids from cmd_presets_list) to the selection or `ids`, at `amount` percent (0..200, default 100).

tools.name: cmd_activity_cancel
tools.description: Cancel Background Task (command `activity.cancel`). Params: {id} | {all: true} → {cancelled: n} — ask a task (or every cancellable task) to stop; it stops at its next file or photo (a preview build also stops between a photo's own previews). An unknown id (it may have just finished) or a task that can't be cancelled is an error.

tools.name: cmd_activity_list
tools.description: Background Tasks (command `activity.list`). Params: {} → {tasks: [{id, kind, label, done, total, unit: count|bytes|percent, detail, cancellable, cancelling, ageMs}]} — the long-running tasks in flight (imports, exports, preview builds, downloads, the face scan…), oldest first; total 0 = not known yet.

tools.name: cmd_album_addPhotos
tools.description: Add to Album (command `album.addPhotos`). Params: {id: albumId, ids?: [photoIds]} (default: selection) → {added, skipped}; Local photos are skipped (albums hold library photos), only Local ones is an error; ids the library doesn't have are dropped; nothing new to add changes nothing (no undo step). Menu: Photo.

tools.name: cmd_album_clearQuick
tools.description: Clear Quick Collection (command `album.clearQuick`). Params: {}.

tools.name: cmd_album_create
tools.description: New Album (command `album.create`). Params: {name, parent?: folderId, folder?: bool, addSelected?: bool} → {id, skipped} (skipped: Local photos of the selection, which albums can't hold). Menu: File.

tools.name: cmd_album_createSmart
tools.description: New Smart Album… (command `album.createSmart`). Params: {name, rules?: partial Filter (rating, ratingOp, flag, flags, label, labels, kind, edited, keyword, camera, lens, dateFrom, dateTo, date, text, album, ruleSet: {match: all|any|none, rules: [{field, op, value} | {group: ruleSet}]} — see album.ruleFields), parent?: folderId} — without `rules`, saves the current view (source + filter).

tools.name: cmd_album_delete
tools.description: Delete Album (command `album.delete`). Params: {id} — deletes the album or folder and its descendants, keeping photos in the library; one undo step.

tools.name: cmd_album_move
tools.description: Move Album (command `album.move`). Params: {id, parent?: folderId|null}.

tools.name: cmd_album_removePhotos
tools.description: Remove from Album (command `album.removePhotos`). Params: {id?: albumId (default: the album on screen), ids?} — takes the photos out of the album only: they stay in the library and in their folders (issue #1805; photo.delete removes them from the library) → {removed, album: name}. Menu: Photo.

tools.name: cmd_album_rename
tools.description: Rename Album (command `album.rename`). Params: {id, name}.

tools.name: cmd_album_reorder
tools.description: Reorder Album (command `album.reorder`). Params: {id, parent?: folderId|null, before?: albumId|null} — places the album (or folder) in `parent` (default: where it is; null: the top level) before the sibling `before` of the same kind, or last of its kind; the folder is then ordered by hand. One undo step. → {changed}: how many edits it took (0: already there).

tools.name: cmd_album_ruleFields
tools.description: Smart Album Rule Fields (command `album.ruleFields`). Params: {} → [{field, label, kind (text|keywords|number|date|choice|bool|album: an album id), group (field-menu submenu, null at the top level), ops: [{op, label}], choices? (ids), choiceLabels? ({id: label})}] for ruleSet rules, in menu order.

tools.name: cmd_album_setCover
tools.description: Set as Album Cover (command `album.setCover`). Params: {id: albumId, photo?: photoId}.

tools.name: cmd_album_setRules
tools.description: Edit Smart Album (command `album.setRules`). Params: {id, rules?: partial Filter merged onto the current rules (null clears a field), replace?: bool, fromView?: bool (use the current view), name?: also rename it (blank keeps the name) — one undo step, both or neither}.

tools.name: cmd_album_setTarget
tools.description: Set as Target Album (command `album.setTarget`). Params: {id: albumId | null} (null = the Quick Collection).

tools.name: cmd_album_sort
tools.description: Sort Albums by Name (command `album.sort`). Params: {parent?: folderId|null} — drops the hand order of the albums inside the folder (default: the top level), so they are listed by name → {changed}: how many albums lost their place.

tools.name: cmd_album_toggleTarget
tools.description: Add to Target Album (command `album.toggleTarget`). Params: {ids?} — B: adds the photos to the target album (the Quick Collection unless one is set), or removes them when they're all in it → {album, added, toggled, skipped}; Local photos are skipped, ids the library doesn't have are dropped (none left: nothing changes and `added` is null).

tools.name: cmd_albums_list
tools.description: List Albums (command `albums.list`). Params: {}.

tools.name: cmd_app_export
tools.description: Export Now (command `app.export`). Params: {path?: output file (.jpg/.png/.tif/.webp/.avif/.jxl/.psd/.dng) | dir?, ids?, preset?, format?: jpeg|png|tiff|webp|avif|jxl|psd|dng|original, longEdge?|shortEdge?|width?|height?|megapixels?|percent? (default longEdge 3000; longEdge 0 = full size), fit?: dimensions|widthHeight (with width + height: dimensions fits either orientation, widthHeight limits the width to `width` and the height to `height`), dontEnlarge?, ppi?, quality?: 1..100, jxlLossless?, jxlEffort?: fast|normal, jxlProgressive?, limitKb?, colorSpace?: srgb|displayP3|adobeRgb|proPhoto|rec2020, bitDepth?: 8|10|16|32, hdr? (HDR output for HDR edits: gain map JPEG, PQ AVIF / PNG / JPEG XL, float TIFF), sharpen?: none|screen|matte|glossy, sharpenAmount?: low|standard|high, metadata?: all|allExceptCamera|copyright|none, removeLocation?, naming?, startNumber?, destinationMode?: specificFolder|sameAsOriginal (sameAsOriginal = each photo into its original's folder; `dir` unused), subfolder?, conflict?: unique|overwrite|skip, tiffCompression?: none|lzw|zip (default zip; lzw is usually larger and slower than zip, at 16 bit often larger than none: only for software that needs LZW), dngCompression?: lossless|deflate|uncompressed, addToPhotos?: bool (macOS: then add the files written to Apple Photos; outcome in `applePhotos`), photosAlbum?: top-level album name (made when missing), watermark?: text | {text?, vertical? (upright columns, right to left), size? (text height, 0.005..0.5 of the short edge; default 0.035), opacity? (0..1; 0.7), anchor?: topLeft|top|topRight|left|center|right|bottomLeft|bottom|bottomRight, insetX? (margin from the left/right edge, 0..0.4 of the short edge; 0.025), insetY? (from the top/bottom edge; 0.025), inset? (sets both), rotation?: 0|90|180|270 (degrees clockwise; 0), color? [r,g,b] sRGB, shadow?, image? (graphic drawn instead of the text), imageWidth? (0.01..1 of the photo's width; 0.2)}} — an unknown parameter, an out-of-range watermark size or a value of the wrong kind is an error, not a default.

tools.name: cmd_app_gpu
tools.description: GPU Rendering (command `app.gpu`). Params: {enabled?: bool, wait?: bool} — allow/forbid GPU rendering (CPU fallback; LIGHTCRAFT_GPU=0 forbids it for the process); returns {enabled, available, adapter, reason (why the GPU is off), lastFallback (latest render redone on the CPU, and why)}. wait: false never waits for a device still being created (available, adapter and reason are then null and the device is created in the background; with GPU rendering off they say so at once).

tools.name: cmd_app_memoryBudget
tools.description: Memory Budget (command `app.memoryBudget`). Params: {mb?: number} — set the memory budget shared by the caches (default: a quarter of RAM, at most 1536 MB); returns the report.

tools.name: cmd_beforeAfter_copyAfterToBefore
tools.description: Copy After's Settings to Before (command `beforeAfter.copyAfterToBefore`). Params: {}. Menu: View › Before/After Settings.

tools.name: cmd_beforeAfter_copyBeforeToAfter
tools.description: Copy Before's Settings to After (command `beforeAfter.copyBeforeToAfter`). Params: {}. Menu: View › Before/After Settings.

tools.name: cmd_beforeAfter_resetBefore
tools.description: Reset Before to Import State (command `beforeAfter.resetBefore`). Params: {}. Menu: View › Before/After Settings.

tools.name: cmd_beforeAfter_setBefore
tools.description: Set Before (command `beforeAfter.setBefore`). Params: {source: import|current|history|version, index? (history step), name? (version)} — what the before side shows (this session).

tools.name: cmd_beforeAfter_swap
tools.description: Swap Before and After Settings (command `beforeAfter.swap`). Params: {}. Menu: View › Before/After Settings.

tools.name: cmd_catalog_query
tools.description: Query Photos (command `catalog.query`). Params: {filter?: Filter, sort?: Sort, offset?, limit?} — omit filter to list the current view.

tools.name: cmd_catalog_stats
tools.description: Catalog Statistics (command `catalog.stats`). Params: {}.

tools.name: cmd_crop_aspect
tools.description: Crop Aspect (command `crop.aspect`). Params: {aspect: "original"|"free"|"current" (lock the crop's present shape)|"toggle" (lock ↔ free)|"1x1"|"4x5"|"8.5x11"|"5x7"|"2x3"|"4x3"|"16x9"|"16x10"|[w,h], orientation?: "crop"|"given"} — a named ratio takes the crop's present orientation (landscape, or portrait after X); [w,h] is used as given (taller than wide → portrait); `orientation` overrides either.

tools.name: cmd_crop_autoStraighten
tools.description: Auto Straighten (command `crop.autoStraighten`). Params: {} — level the horizon (or plumb lines) with the crop angle.

tools.name: cmd_crop_drag
tools.description: Drag Crop Handle (command `crop.drag`). Params: {handle: topLeft|topRight|bottomRight|bottomLeft|top|right|bottom|left|move | 0..8, from: [x,y], to: [x,y] (normalized, straightened frame), start?: [x0,y0,x1,y1] (default: the current crop), keepRatio?: bool (default false)} — drags a crop handle; stops at the image edge, keeps the opposite edges, honours the aspect lock; keepRatio holds the frame's current proportions for this drag even with the lock off (the UI sends it while Shift is held).

tools.name: cmd_crop_reset
tools.description: Reset Crop (command `crop.reset`). Params: {}. Shortcut: Cmd+Alt+R.

tools.name: cmd_crop_rotateAspect
tools.description: Rotate Crop Aspect (command `crop.rotateAspect`). Params: {}. Shortcut: X.

tools.name: cmd_crop_set
tools.description: Set Crop (command `crop.set`). Params: {rect?: [x0,y0,x1,y1] normalized in the straightened frame, angle?: degrees}.

tools.name: cmd_crop_straighten
tools.description: Straighten (command `crop.straighten`). Params: {angle: degrees -45..45} — keeps the crop if it still fits, else shrinks it about its centre (the largest crop of its aspect stays the largest).

tools.name: cmd_curve_applyPreset
tools.description: Apply Point Curve Preset (command `curve.applyPreset`). Params: {name} — sets the active photo's point curves (all four channels; the parametric curve stays).

tools.name: cmd_curve_deletePreset
tools.description: Delete Point Curve Preset (command `curve.deletePreset`). Params: {name} — a user preset (built-ins can't be deleted).

tools.name: cmd_curve_exportPresets
tools.description: Export Point Curve Presets (command `curve.exportPresets`). Params: {path, names?: [name] (default: every user preset)} — writes a .lccurve JSON file → {path, count}.

tools.name: cmd_curve_importPresets
tools.description: Import Point Curve Presets (command `curve.importPresets`). Params: {path | paths: [file]} — .lccurve JSON files ({format, version, presets: [...]}, an array of presets, or one preset); same-named user presets are replaced → {imported: [name], failed: [[file, error]]}.

tools.name: cmd_curve_presets
tools.description: Point Curve Presets (command `curve.presets`). Params: {} → {presets: [{name, master, red, green, blue: [[x,y],...], builtin?}], current: name of the preset the active photo's point curves match, or null}.

tools.name: cmd_curve_reset
tools.description: Reset Tone Curve (command `curve.reset`). Params: {channel?: all|point|parametric|master|red|green|blue (default all)} — the active photo's tone curve (or one channel) back to linear.

tools.name: cmd_curve_savePreset
tools.description: Save Point Curve Preset (command `curve.savePreset`). Params: {name} — the active photo's point curves under a name (replaces a user preset of that name; built-in names are reserved), saved with the library.

tools.name: cmd_denoise_cancel
tools.description: Cancel Denoise (command `denoise.cancel`). Params: {id?, all?} → {cancelled} — stop the photo being made and/or forget the ones waiting (all of them when `id` is omitted).

tools.name: cmd_denoise_clear
tools.description: Clear Denoise Cache (command `denoise.clear`). Params: {} → {deleted, bytes} — delete every cached denoised picture of this library (they are made again when wanted).

tools.name: cmd_denoise_models_download
tools.description: Download Denoise Model (command `denoise.models.download`). Params: {id, acknowledged: true} → {started, from} — fetch a model LightCraft has a pinned address for (see `downloadHost` in the list) in the background over HTTPS with lightcraft-fetch. `acknowledged` must be true: the user has been shown the model's terms and accepted them. It is checked against its size and SHA-256, installed and chosen by itself; `denoise.models.downloads` shows how far it is.

tools.name: cmd_denoise_models_downloadCancel
tools.description: Cancel Denoise Model Download (command `denoise.models.downloadCancel`). Params: {id} → {discarded} — stop a download, or delete a finished one that was not installed.

tools.name: cmd_denoise_models_downloads
tools.description: Denoise Model Downloads (command `denoise.models.downloads`). Params: {} → {running, downloads: [{id, state: running | done | installed | failed | cancelled, bytes, total, error, from}]} — also installs any download that has arrived.

tools.name: cmd_denoise_models_inspect
tools.description: Inspect Denoise Model (command `denoise.models.inspect`). Params: {path} → model terms from an adjacent manifest; never executes the file.

tools.name: cmd_denoise_models_install
tools.description: Install Denoise Model (command `denoise.models.install`). Params: {path, acknowledged: true, activate?: true, background?: false} → {installed, model} or {started} — install a denoise model from a file: an .onnx with a denoise-model.json beside it, or an archive LightCraft knows (the darktable `.dtmodel`). `acknowledged` must be true: the user has been shown the model's licence and accepted it. Unless `activate` is false it becomes the model in use.

tools.name: cmd_denoise_models_list
tools.description: Denoise Models (command `denoise.models.list`). Params: {} → {dir, productsDir, model, runtime, auto, cacheGb, threads, runOn, models: [{id, name, version, licence{name, commercial, url, notice}, provenance, source, sizeBytes, sha256, tile, known, downloadHost, installed, selected, accepted}]}.

tools.name: cmd_denoise_models_remove
tools.description: Remove Denoise Model (command `denoise.models.remove`). Params: {id} → {removed, model} — delete an installed model (its cached pictures stay until they are evicted).

tools.name: cmd_denoise_models_select
tools.description: Choose Denoise Model (command `denoise.models.select`). Params: {id: installed model | null} → {model} — null switches denoise off.

tools.name: cmd_denoise_models_test
tools.description: Test Denoise Model (command `denoise.models.test`). Params: {id} → {ok, result} — load an installed model and check it gives sensible pictures; needs the denoise runtime.

tools.name: cmd_denoise_pump
tools.description: Denoise Pump (command `denoise.pump`). Params: {pace?: pause | light | normal | full} → {active, running, queued, ready, generation, downloading} — called every frame by the app: takes in finished work and keeps one photo going.

tools.name: cmd_denoise_queue
tools.description: Denoise Photos (command `denoise.queue`). Params: {ids?: [photoId], scope?: selected | visible | withAmount, retry?: false} → {added, …status} — make the denoised pictures of raw photos that have none, in the background. `retry` tries photos that failed before.

tools.name: cmd_denoise_settings
tools.description: Denoise Settings (command `denoise.settings`). Params: {auto?: bool, cacheGb?: 1..10000, threads?: 1..64 | null, runOn?: auto | gpu | cpu} → the settings — `auto`: make the picture of the photos being looked at that have a Denoise amount; `cacheGb`: how much the cached pictures may take; `threads`: most tiles run at once; `runOn`: where the model runs — `auto` (the default) the graphics card where it is faster than the processor (both timed on this computer when the card is set up), `gpu` the card whenever it can run the model, `cpu` the processor. Setting `runOn` also lets the card be tried again after a set-up that failed or closed LightCraft.

tools.name: cmd_denoise_status
tools.description: Denoise Status (command `denoise.status`). Params: {id?} → {enabled, model, runtime, productsDir, queued, running: {photo, done, total, seconds} | null, ready, made, auto, runOn, device: {kind: gpu | cpu | pending | none, adapter?, reason?, cardMs?, cpuMs?, fellBack?, remote?: {address, state: pending | unavailable | used | idle | slower | given up, device?, remoteMs?, localMs?, reason?, failures?, lastError?}}, cache: {files, bytes, limitBytes}, generation, photo?: {state: notApplicable | noModel | ready | queued | running | failed | idle, …}}.

tools.name: cmd_denoise_toggle
tools.description: AI Denoise (command `denoise.toggle`). Params: {id?: photoId, enabled?: bool} → {id, enabled, amount} — turn AI Denoise on (50% initially) or off for one raw photo, independent of selection and Auto Sync; needs an installed model to turn on.

tools.name: cmd_develop_adjust
tools.description: Nudge Develop Value (command `develop.adjust`). Params: {control, delta}.

tools.name: cmd_develop_auto
tools.description: Auto Settings (command `develop.auto`). Params: {}. Menu: Photo. Shortcut: Shift+A.

tools.name: cmd_develop_autoBwMix
tools.description: Auto B&W Mix (command `develop.autoBwMix`). Params: {} — sets the black & white mix from the photo's colours (and switches to B&W).

tools.name: cmd_develop_autoSync
tools.description: Auto Sync (command `develop.autoSync`). Params: {on?: bool} (toggles when omitted) — edits to the active photo also change the other selected photos (only the settings that changed; not spot removal / red eye) → {on}. Menu: Edit. Shortcut: Cmd+Alt+Shift+A.

tools.name: cmd_develop_beginInteraction
tools.description: Begin Interaction (command `develop.beginInteraction`). Params: {label}.

tools.name: cmd_develop_cancelInteraction
tools.description: Cancel Interaction (command `develop.cancelInteraction`). Params: {}.

tools.name: cmd_develop_controls
tools.description: List Develop Controls (command `develop.controls`). Params: {section?} — every slider with range, default and current value.

tools.name: cmd_develop_copy
tools.description: Copy Edit Settings (command `develop.copy`). Params: {groups?: [settingsGroup]} (default: all but crop, masks, remove). Menu: Edit. Shortcut: Cmd+C.

tools.name: cmd_develop_curve
tools.description: Set Point Curve (command `develop.curve`). Params: {channel: master|red|green|blue, points: [[x,y],...] in 0..1}.

tools.name: cmd_develop_endInteraction
tools.description: End Interaction (command `develop.endInteraction`). Params: {}.

tools.name: cmd_develop_get
tools.description: Get Develop Settings (command `develop.get`). Params: {id?} → the photo's develop settings; `process` is the rendering process they are interpreted by (see develop.updateProcess).

tools.name: cmd_develop_hdr
tools.description: HDR (command `develop.hdr`). Params: {enabled?: bool (default: toggle), maxEv?: number 0..5 (headroom limit, stops above SDR white)} — HDR editing: highlights above SDR white for HDR exports and displays; every SDR render uses the SDR rendition (the hdr.sdr* controls).

tools.name: cmd_develop_matchExposure
tools.description: Match Total Exposures (command `develop.matchExposure`). Params: {ids?} — set each selected photo's Exposure so its total exposure (shutter × ISO ÷ aperture², plus the slider) equals the active photo's; photos without exposure data are skipped → {changed, skipped}. Menu: Photo.

tools.name: cmd_develop_merge
tools.description: Apply Settings JSON (command `develop.merge`). Params: {settings: partial DevelopSettings JSON, label?}.

tools.name: cmd_develop_paste
tools.description: Paste Edit Settings (command `develop.paste`). Params: {ids?, groups?: [settingsGroup] (paste only these of the copied groups)}. Menu: Edit. Shortcut: Cmd+V.

tools.name: cmd_develop_pastePrevious
tools.description: Paste Settings from Previous (command `develop.pastePrevious`). Params: {ids?, groups?: [settingsGroup] (default: the copy groups)} — from the photo that was active before this one. Menu: Edit. Shortcut: Cmd+Alt+V.

tools.name: cmd_develop_profile
tools.description: Set Profile (command `develop.profile`). Params: {id: profile id (see profiles.list), amount?: 0..200}.

tools.name: cmd_develop_quickAdjust
tools.description: Quick Develop (command `develop.quickAdjust`). Params: {control: develop control id, delta, ids?} — add `delta` to the control on every target photo (each from its own value; Quick Develop) in one undo step → {changed}.

tools.name: cmd_develop_reset
tools.description: Reset Edits (command `develop.reset`). Params: {ids?}. Menu: Photo. Shortcut: Cmd+Shift+R.

tools.name: cmd_develop_resetControl
tools.description: Reset Control (command `develop.resetControl`). Params: {control}.

tools.name: cmd_develop_resetSection
tools.description: Reset Section (command `develop.resetSection`). Params: {section: profile|light|curve|color|mixer|grading|effects|vignette|grain|detail|optics|geometry}.

tools.name: cmd_develop_sectionEnabled
tools.description: Toggle Section (command `develop.sectionEnabled`). Params: {section: string, enabled: bool}.

tools.name: cmd_develop_set
tools.description: Set Develop Values (command `develop.set`). Params: {control?: controlId, value?: number, values?: {controlId: number}, ids?: [photo]} — see develop.controls; `crop.angle` turns the crop as crop.straighten does (kept if it still fits, else the largest of its aspect inside the photo).

tools.name: cmd_develop_sync
tools.description: Sync Settings (command `develop.sync`). Params: {groups?} — copy the active photo's settings to all selected photos.

tools.name: cmd_develop_targeted
tools.description: Targeted Adjustment (command `develop.targeted`). Params: {target: curve|hue|sat|lum, x, y (normalized image coords), delta (slider units; point curves: output levels 0..255), channel?: parametric|master|red|green|blue (curve)} — adjusts the curve region / colour-mixer bands under the point; returns the changed controls.

tools.name: cmd_develop_treatment
tools.description: Black & White (command `develop.treatment`). Params: {bw?: bool} (toggles when omitted). Menu: Photo. Shortcut: V.

tools.name: cmd_develop_updateProcess
tools.description: Update to Current Process (command `develop.updateProcess`). Params: {ids?}: moves the target photos (`ids`, else the selection) that are on an older rendering process to the current one, as one undo step (their look can change; the sliders keep their values; see docs/process-versions.md). Enabled while a selected photo is on an older process; named photos are checked themselves (each must exist, one must be on an older process) → {changed, process}. Menu: Photo.

tools.name: cmd_develop_wb
tools.description: White Balance (command `develop.wb`). Params: {mode: asShot|auto|daylight|cloudy|shade|tungsten|fluorescent|flash|custom, temp?, tint?}.

tools.name: cmd_develop_wbPick
tools.description: White Balance Selector (command `develop.wbPick`). Params: {x, y} normalized image coords of a neutral point. Shortcut: W.

tools.name: cmd_edit_redo
tools.description: Redo (command `edit.redo`). Params: {}. Menu: Edit. Shortcut: Cmd+Shift+Z.

tools.name: cmd_edit_undo
tools.description: Undo (command `edit.undo`). Params: {}. Menu: Edit. Shortcut: Cmd+Z.

tools.name: cmd_export_addToPhotos
tools.description: Add to Apple Photos (command `export.addToPhotos`). Params: {paths: [absolute file paths], album?: name (an album at the top level of Photos, made when missing; default none), wait?} → once Photos is done, {job, running: false, requested, album, imported, ids: [Photos media item ids], warning?}; with wait: false, at once {job, running: true, requested, album} and the outcome later from export.photosImports {job}. wait defaults to true without a window (lightcraft-cli, the MCP server) and to false in the desktop app, where wait: true is refused (its control requests are answered on the UI thread, which never waits for Photos). macOS: asks Photos to import the files (the first time, macOS asks the user to allow LightCraft to control Photos). One import runs at a time, and an export adding to Photos reserves it before writing: another is refused until it ends. app.export does this for the files it writes with `addToPhotos: true`.

tools.name: cmd_export_checkTarget
tools.description: Check Output Path (command `export.checkTarget`). Params: {path} — fails when writing `path` would replace a photo's original (or its XMP sidecar) in the library; front ends call it before saving a render or screenshot to a user-given path → {path}.

tools.name: cmd_export_contactSheet
tools.description: Export Contact Sheet PDF (command `export.contactSheet`). Params: {path, ids?: photo ids (default selection), paper?: a4|letter, landscape?: bool, columns?: 1..8, rows?: 1..10, captions?: bool} → {path, pages, photos, bytes}; replaces an existing output, never an original.

tools.name: cmd_export_deletePreset
tools.description: Delete Export Preset (command `export.deletePreset`). Params: {name} — removes a user preset → presets.

tools.name: cmd_export_photosImports
tools.description: Apple Photos Imports (command `export.photosImports`). Params: {job?} → {imports: [{job, running, exporting?, requested, album, imported?, ids?, warning?, error?, skipped?}]} (this session's, oldest first), or the one job: how Add to Apple Photos is getting on (exporting: reserved by an export still writing its files).

tools.name: cmd_export_presets
tools.description: Export Presets (command `export.presets`). Params: {} → [{name, builtin, params}] (use with app.export {preset: name, …overrides}).

tools.name: cmd_export_savePreset
tools.description: Save Export Preset (command `export.savePreset`). Params: {name, params?: app.export params (default: the last export's)} — adds or replaces a user preset, saved with the library → presets.

tools.name: cmd_faces_detect
tools.description: Detect Faces (command `faces.detect`). Params: {ids?, apply?: bool (default true), score?: 0.6, nmsIou?: 0.3, maxFaces?} → {photos: [{id, faces: [{rect, score, landmarks}]}]}. Finds faces with the YuNet detector (download it first: `faces.models.download {id: "yunet-2023mar"}`) and, unless `apply` is false, adds them as unnamed face regions (one undo step), replacing earlier detections but never regions from XMP or ones you named; the sidecar is not touched. Menu: Photo.

tools.name: cmd_faces_enable
tools.description: Face Recognition On/Off (command `faces.enable`). Params: {enabled?: bool} (toggles when omitted).

tools.name: cmd_faces_evaluate
tools.description: Evaluate Face Recognition (command `faces.evaluate`). Params: {budgetMs?: 0, burstSecs?: 5, margin?, thresholds?: [..], scope?: "visible"} → {queries, top1, sweep: [{threshold, suggested, correct, precision, recall}]} — leave-one-out over your named faces: each is ranked against the others (ignoring shots within burstSecs of it) to show how well the chosen model recognises people in *your* photos and which threshold to trust. Faces not yet embedded are done within budgetMs (`faces.index` does them all); counts only.

tools.name: cmd_faces_gpu
tools.description: Face Models on the GPU (command `faces.gpu`). Params: {cpuOnly?: bool} → {cpuOnly, detection, recognition}: where the face models run, each as {checking, device, why} (null until it is loaded). The GPU is used only after a background check shows it gives the CPU's results faster; `cpuOnly: true` keeps every face model on the CPU (Settings ▸ Faces), `false` checks the GPU again.

tools.name: cmd_faces_index
tools.description: Index Faces (command `faces.index`). Params: {budgetMs?: 200, ids?: [photo ids to do first]} → {embedded, photosDone, pendingPhotos, indexedFaces, ms} — embed the faces in the library with the chosen recognition model, as many photos as fit in the time (at least one); call again until `pendingPhotos` is 0. `budgetMs: 0` only reports.

tools.name: cmd_faces_models_download
tools.description: Download Face Model (command `faces.models.download`). Params: {id, acknowledged: true} → {started, from} — fetch a recognition model LightCraft has a pinned address for (see `downloadHost` in the list), in the background over pure-Rust https (lightcraft-fetch). `acknowledged` must be true: the user has been shown the model's terms and accepted them. It is checked against its size and SHA-256, then installed, chosen and switched on by itself; `faces.models.downloads` shows how far it is.

tools.name: cmd_faces_models_downloadCancel
tools.description: Cancel Face Model Download (command `faces.models.downloadCancel`). Params: {id} → {discarded} — stop a download, or delete a finished one that was not installed.

tools.name: cmd_faces_models_downloads
tools.description: Face Model Downloads (command `faces.models.downloads`). Params: {} → {running, downloads: [{id, state: running | done | installed | failed | cancelled, bytes, total, error, from}]} — also installs any download that has arrived; `installed` stays listed until `faces.models.downloadCancel` clears it.

tools.name: cmd_faces_models_inspect
tools.description: Inspect Face Model File (command `faces.models.inspect`). Params: {path} → what a .onnx file is: {kind: known | draft | unsupported, model, assumptions, reason, alreadyInstalled}; installs nothing.

tools.name: cmd_faces_models_install
tools.description: Install Face Model (command `faces.models.install`). Params: {path, acknowledged: true, activate?: true} → {installed, active: {embedder, enabled}} — copy a .onnx face recognition model into the models folder. `acknowledged` must be true: the user has been shown its licence (see inspect) and accepted it. Unless `activate` is false the model becomes the one in use and recognition is switched on; an earlier model stays installed.

tools.name: cmd_faces_models_list
tools.description: Face Models (command `faces.models.list`). Params: {} → {dir, enabled, embedder, runtime, models: [{id, name, role, licence{name, commercial, url, notice}, provenance, source, sizeBytes, known, installed, selected}]}.

tools.name: cmd_faces_models_remove
tools.description: Remove Face Model (command `faces.models.remove`). Params: {id} — delete an installed model.

tools.name: cmd_faces_models_select
tools.description: Choose Face Recognition Model (command `faces.models.select`). Params: {id: installed recogniser | null}.

tools.name: cmd_faces_models_test
tools.description: Test Face Model (command `faces.models.test`). Params: {id} → {ok, result: {loadMs, embedMs, dimension, checks}} — load an installed recognition model and check it gives sensible faces; needs the recognition runtime.

tools.name: cmd_faces_nameFaces
tools.description: Name Faces (command `faces.nameFaces`). Params: {faces: [{photo, index}], name} → {named, photos} — name (or, with a null or empty name, clear) many face regions as one undoable step; the sidecar is not touched.

tools.name: cmd_faces_person
tools.description: Faces of a Person (command `faces.person`). Params: {name, more?: 120} → {name, total, confirmed: [{photo, index, rect}], more: [{photo, index, rect, score}], ready, pendingPhotos} — the faces named `name` across the library, and the unnamed faces that look most like them (best first, already embedded ones only, once recognition is on); confirm one with `faces.setName`.

tools.name: cmd_faces_pump
tools.description: Index Faces in the Background (command `faces.pump`). Params: {pace?: pause | light | normal | full} → {active, inFlight, pendingPhotos, indexedFaces, searchedPhotos, workers} — cheap to call every frame: takes in what the background workers have finished and gives them the next photos, as many at once as the pace allows (none when paused, one when light, half the machine's threads when normal, four fifths when full); inactive until face recognition is on in Settings with a model chosen.

tools.name: cmd_faces_renamePerson
tools.description: Rename Person (command `faces.renamePerson`). Params: {from, to, merge?: bool} → {faces, photos, from, to, merged} — give every in-library face of `from` the name `to` (trimmed, any capitalization), one undo step; refused when `to` is already someone else unless `merge` is true, which combines the two; the sidecar is not touched.

tools.name: cmd_faces_setName
tools.description: Name Face (command `faces.setName`). Params: {id?, index, name} — name a face region (null or empty clears it); undoable; the sidecar is not touched.

tools.name: cmd_faces_suggest
tools.description: Suggest Names for Faces (command `faces.suggest`). Params: {ids?, threshold?, margin?, budgetMs?} → {photos: [{id, faces: [{index, suggestion: {name, score, runnerUp} | null, candidates: [{name, score}]}]}]} — who the unnamed faces in these photos might be, from the faces already named in the library. Only suggestions: nothing is named.

tools.name: cmd_faces_unnamed
tools.description: Unnamed Faces (command `faces.unnamed`). Params: {limit?: 600} → {total, faces: [{photo, index, rect, view, suggestion: {name, score} | null}], ordered, ready} — the faces nobody has named; with recognition running, look-alikes are next to each other and a face the named ones recognise carries the name they suggest. `view` is the box to show the face by. Name them with `faces.nameFaces`.

tools.name: cmd_filter_applyPreset
tools.description: Apply Filter Preset (command `filter.applyPreset`). Params: {name} — replaces the current filter → {photos}.

tools.name: cmd_filter_deletePreset
tools.description: Delete Filter Preset (command `filter.deletePreset`). Params: {name}.

tools.name: cmd_filter_presets
tools.description: Filter Presets (command `filter.presets`). Params: {} → [{name, filter}].

tools.name: cmd_filter_savePreset
tools.description: Save Filter Preset (command `filter.savePreset`). Params: {name} — the current filter (library.filter), saved with the library.

tools.name: cmd_focus_pump
tools.description: Read Focus Points in the Background (command `focus.pump`). Params: {pace?: pause | light | normal} → {active, running?: {done, total, found}, last?, lookedAt} — cheap to call every frame (the app does): takes in what the background focus-point reader has read and commits it in batches; reads nothing new while paused and rests between files when light. Starts the reader by itself once per library opening when photos are left to look at.

tools.name: cmd_folder_create
tools.description: New Folder on Disk (command `folder.create`). Params: {parent, name} — create a folder on disk inside `parent` (refused if the name is taken); one undo step (undo removes it again while it is empty) → {path}.

tools.name: cmd_folder_label
tools.description: Set Folder Color Label (command `folder.label`). Params: {path, label: red|yellow|green|blue|purple|none} — give a folder of the library (one its photos were imported from, see library.folders) a colour label, or take it off (also once its photos are gone); one undo step. The label follows the folder when it is renamed or moved with folder.rename / folder.move → {path, label}.

tools.name: cmd_folder_move
tools.description: Move Folder (command `folder.move`). Params: {path, into: destination folder} — move a folder on disk into another and relink the photos in it; one undo step (undo moves it back, refused if the old place is taken); refused for the home folder and its Pictures, Desktop and Downloads → {path, relinked}.

tools.name: cmd_folder_rename
tools.description: Rename Folder (command `folder.rename`). Params: {path, name} — rename a folder on disk (its files and sidecars go along) and relink the photos in it; one undo step (undo renames it back, refused if the old name is taken); refused for the home folder and its Pictures, Desktop and Downloads → {path, relinked}.

tools.name: cmd_folder_scanChanges
tools.description: Scan Folder for Changes (command `folder.scanChanges`). Params: {path, disk?: bool (a whole disk or share, or a folder holding disks)} — compare a folder of the library (and the folders inside it) with the disk; changes nothing → {path, new: [{path, name, format, …}] files the library doesn't have, duplicates: files whose content it already has, unreadable: [{path, error}], missing: [{id, path}] photos whose file is gone, moved: [{id, from, to}] photos whose file is elsewhere in the folder (same content), metadata: [{id, path}] photos whose XMP sidecar was saved after they came in or were last edited here and says something the library doesn't}.

tools.name: cmd_folder_synchronize
tools.description: Synchronize Folder (command `folder.synchronize`). Params: {path, disk?: bool, scanned?: bool, importNew?: true, relinkMoved?: true, removeMissing?: false, readMetadata?: false} — bring a folder of the library up to date with the disk (see folder.scanChanges): import its new files in place, relink photos whose file was renamed or moved within it, move photos whose file is gone to Recently Deleted, read XMP sidecars saved by other apps (the sidecar wins); acts on the last folder.scanChanges of the folder while it is current (the folder's photos unchanged), else scans again — or, with `scanned: true`, refuses; one undo step, no file is touched → {imported, relinked, removed, read, failed: [[path, error]]}.

tools.name: cmd_geometry_guides
tools.description: Guided Upright Guides (command `geometry.guides`). Params: {guides: [[x0,y0,x1,y1], …] (≤ 4, normalized coords of the lens-corrected image), add?: bool (append one guide, dropping the oldest beyond 4)} — switches Upright to Guided.

tools.name: cmd_geometry_upright
tools.description: Upright (command `geometry.upright`). Params: {mode: off|auto|guided|level|vertical|full} — analyses the photo (line segments → vanishing points) and stores the correction; run again to update after lens changes.

tools.name: cmd_history_clear
tools.description: Clear History (command `history.clear`). Params: {} — keeps the current settings as the only step.

tools.name: cmd_history_list
tools.description: List History (command `history.list`). Params: {id?} — returns {history: labels oldest first, cursor: index of the step the settings are at (later steps can be returned to), versions}.

tools.name: cmd_history_next
tools.description: Next History Step (command `history.next`). Params: {} — steps the History cursor forward one step.

tools.name: cmd_history_previous
tools.description: Previous History Step (command `history.previous`). Params: {} — steps the History cursor back one step.

tools.name: cmd_history_restore
tools.description: Go to History Step (command `history.restore`). Params: {index} — loads that step's settings and moves the History cursor there; later steps stay listed until a new edit.

tools.name: cmd_journal_list
tools.description: Command Journal (command `journal.list`). Params: {limit?}.

tools.name: cmd_keyword_create
tools.description: Create Keyword (command `keyword.create`). Params: {name, parent?: keyword | null (default: the default parent; null = the top level), synonyms?, includeOnExport?, exportContaining?, exportSynonyms?, person?, addToSelected?: bool, ids?} → {keyword}.

tools.name: cmd_keyword_delete
tools.description: Delete Keyword (command `keyword.delete`). Params: {keyword} — removes it (and the keywords below it) from every photo.

tools.name: cmd_keyword_deleteSet
tools.description: Delete Keyword Set (command `keyword.deleteSet`). Params: {name}.

tools.name: cmd_keyword_edit
tools.description: Edit Keyword (command `keyword.edit`). Params: {keyword, name?: its new name (one level), synonyms?, includeOnExport?, exportContaining?, exportSynonyms?, person?} — what isn't given keeps its value.

tools.name: cmd_keyword_export
tools.description: Export Keywords (command `keyword.export`). Params: {path?} — the keyword list as a file (Lightroom Classic's format, which Capture One, Photo Supreme and Bridge read) → {keywords, captureOneRefuses: keywords with ; , < > that Capture One's importer refuses, unwritable: keywords left out because the format can't hold them (a name in brackets or braces, a line break, deeper than 64 levels; a synonym as "path {synonym}"), text when there is no path}.

tools.name: cmd_keyword_import
tools.description: Import Keywords (command `keyword.import`). Params: {path | text} — a keyword list (Lightroom Classic's format, also Capture One's and Photo Supreme's Formatted Vocabulary File): adds the keywords the library doesn't have, gives those it has the list's synonyms; one undo step → {added, updated}.

tools.name: cmd_keyword_info
tools.description: Keyword Info (command `keyword.info`). Params: {keyword} → {path, listed, count, synonyms, includeOnExport, exportContaining, exportSynonyms, person}.

tools.name: cmd_keyword_list
tools.description: Keywords (command `keyword.list`). Params: {} → [{name, path, count, children}] keyword tree (`a|b|c` keywords are hierarchical).

tools.name: cmd_keyword_merge
tools.description: Merge Keywords (command `keyword.merge`). Params: {from: [keyword], into: keyword} — replaces each `from` keyword (children included) with `into` on every photo.

tools.name: cmd_keyword_move
tools.description: Move Keyword (command `keyword.move`). Params: {keyword, parent: keyword | null (the top level), merge?: bool} — with the keywords below it; onto a name that is taken only with `merge: true`.

tools.name: cmd_keyword_nextSet
tools.description: Next Keyword Set (command `keyword.nextSet`). Params: {}: the set after the current one (after the last, Recent Keywords). Shortcut: Alt+0.

tools.name: cmd_keyword_previousSet
tools.description: Previous Keyword Set (command `keyword.previousSet`). Params: {}: the set before the current one (before Recent Keywords, the last). Shortcut: Alt+Shift+0.

tools.name: cmd_keyword_purgeUnused
tools.description: Purge Unused Keywords (command `keyword.purgeUnused`). Params: {} — takes off the keyword list the keywords no photo has → {purged}.

tools.name: cmd_keyword_rename
tools.description: Rename Keyword (command `keyword.rename`). Params: {from, to} — on every photo, children included (`a` → `b` renames `a|x` to `b|x`); renaming onto an existing keyword merges them.

tools.name: cmd_keyword_saveSet
tools.description: Save Keyword Set (command `keyword.saveSet`). Params: {name, keywords?: [up to 9, "" = an empty slot] (default: the renamed set's, else the current nine), replace?: the set it renames, new?: refuse a name another set has} — replaces a set of that name (or `replace`, in its place) and makes it current.

tools.name: cmd_keyword_setDefaultParent
tools.description: Put New Keywords Inside (command `keyword.setDefaultParent`). Params: {keyword: keyword | null} — the parent keyword.create puts new keywords inside (null: the top level).

tools.name: cmd_keyword_setShortcut
tools.description: Set Keyword Shortcut (command `keyword.setShortcut`). Params: {keywords: [..] or "a, b" (none clears it)}: sets the keyword shortcut, a mark on its keywords in the keyword list (a new name is listed; one undo step) → {keywords}.

tools.name: cmd_keyword_sets
tools.description: Keyword Sets (command `keyword.sets`). Params: {} → {sets: [{name, keywords}], current, keywords: the nine ⌥1–⌥9 apply}.

tools.name: cmd_keyword_shortcut
tools.description: Keyword Shortcut (command `keyword.shortcut`). Params: {} → {keywords: the keyword shortcut's, which ⇧K adds or removes}.

tools.name: cmd_keyword_suggest
tools.description: Keyword Suggestions (command `keyword.suggest`). Params: {prefix?: typed text, ids?, limit?: 12} → keywords to suggest for the photos (co-occurring / most used, or matching the prefix).

tools.name: cmd_keyword_toggleFromSet
tools.description: Toggle Keyword from Set (command `keyword.toggleFromSet`). Params: {index: 1..9, ids?} — the set's keyword N: added to the target photos, or removed when they all have it.

tools.name: cmd_keyword_toggleShortcut
tools.description: Add or Remove Keyword Shortcut (command `keyword.toggleShortcut`). Params: {ids?}: removes the keyword shortcut's keywords from the target photos when they all have every one, else adds them → {changed, keywords, added}. Shortcut: Shift+K.

tools.name: cmd_keyword_useSet
tools.description: Use Keyword Set (command `keyword.useSet`). Params: {name} ("Recent Keywords" = the recently added ones).

tools.name: cmd_label_applySet
tools.description: Apply Color Label Set (command `label.applySet`). Params: {name} — use a set's label names (undoable).

tools.name: cmd_label_deleteSet
tools.description: Delete Color Label Set (command `label.deleteSet`). Params: {name} — user sets only.

tools.name: cmd_label_names
tools.description: Color Label Names (command `label.names`). Params: {} → [{label, name, custom}].

tools.name: cmd_label_saveSet
tools.description: Save Color Label Set (command `label.saveSet`). Params: {name} — save the current label names as a set (replaces a user set of that name).

tools.name: cmd_label_setNames
tools.description: Edit Color Label Names (command `label.setNames`). Params: {names: {red?: name|null, yellow?, green?, blue?, purple?}} — null or empty restores the colour's name.

tools.name: cmd_label_sets
tools.description: Color Label Sets (command `label.sets`). Params: {} → {sets: [{name, names: [red, yellow, green, blue, purple], builtin}], current: name|null}.

tools.name: cmd_lens_databaseStatus
tools.description: Lens Database Status (command `lens.databaseStatus`). Params: {} → {download: {state: idle|running|done|failed|cancelled, …}, dir, lenses (in the database in use)}.

tools.name: cmd_lens_downloadDatabase
tools.description: Download the Lens Database (command `lens.downloadDatabase`). Params: {} — fetch lensfun's lens database (CC BY-SA 3.0, pinned to one commit, checked file by file) into the app's data folder in the background, with an activity row, and read lens profiles from it once it is in place (unless LIGHTCRAFT_LENSFUN_DIR names another folder); the desktop app offers it on its first launch and in Settings. LIGHTCRAFT_LENSFUN_URL lists other places to fetch the same files from → {started, dir}.

tools.name: cmd_library_autoImport
tools.description: Auto Import Settings (command `library.autoImport`). Params: {folder?: path | null (off), copy?: bool (copy into the library's Originals, else add in place), album?: name | null} — a watched folder whose new photos are added as they arrive (library.autoImportScan; the app scans every few seconds) → the settings.

tools.name: cmd_library_autoImportScan
tools.description: Auto Import Now (command `library.autoImportScan`). Params: {listing?: [[path, size]] (the folder as listed by the caller, e.g. on a worker thread), start?: bool (false: return the `library.import` params as `import` instead of importing)} — add the watched folder's new photos (files the library doesn't have yet; partial / still-copying files wait for the next scan) → {imported, folder, warnings?: [{path, code, profile?, mode?, fields?}], import?}.

tools.name: cmd_library_browse
tools.description: Browse Folder (command `library.browse`). Params: {path, subfolders?: bool} — show a folder's photos without adding them to the library (they're read in place; edits go to XMP sidecars) → {path, photos, new}.

tools.name: cmd_library_buildPreviews
tools.description: Build Previews (command `library.buildPreviews`). Params: {size?: standard (2048 px, or `edge`) | full (1:1), ids?, wait?: bool} — render the grid thumbnail and loupe view of the selected photos (else all in view) into the preview cache, in the background unless `wait` → {total, done, failed, running}.

tools.name: cmd_library_cancelPreviews
tools.description: Cancel Preview Build (command `library.cancelPreviews`). Params: {}.

tools.name: cmd_library_clearFilter
tools.description: Clear Filters (command `library.clearFilter`). Params: {}. Menu: View.

tools.name: cmd_library_clearPreviews
tools.description: Discard Preview Cache (command `library.clearPreviews`). Params: {}. Menu: File.

tools.name: cmd_library_compact
tools.description: Optimize Library (command `library.compact`). Params: {}. Menu: File.

tools.name: cmd_library_devices
tools.description: Cameras and Cards (command `library.devices`). Params: {} → [{name, path (its DCIM folder), root}] — mounted volumes with a DCIM folder.

tools.name: cmd_library_down
tools.description: Photo Below (command `library.down`). Params: {rows?: n (photos to move forward; default 1, the grid passes the distance to the cell below)}. Shortcut: Down.

tools.name: cmd_library_emptyRecentlyDeleted
tools.description: Empty Recently Deleted (command `library.emptyRecentlyDeleted`). Params: {} → {deleted} — removes every photo in Recently Deleted from the library (files on disk stay). Menu: Photo.

tools.name: cmd_library_filter
tools.description: Filter (command `library.filter`). Params: partial Filter: {text?, rating?, ratingOp?: atLeast|exactly|atMost, flag?: pick|reject|none|null, flags?: [pick|reject|none] (any of them; [] = no constraint), label?, kind?, merged?: hdr|panorama|hdrPanorama|any, edited?, date?, libraryFolder?: a path from library.folders, keyword?, person?, camera?}.

tools.name: cmd_library_findMissing
tools.description: Find Missing Photos (command `library.findMissing`). Params: {folder} — relink every missing photo whose file is somewhere in the folder: same name and size (and content, when the library knows its hash), or — renamed — same size and content; or {found, missing, ambiguous} — relink what a search already found (the app searches on a worker thread; photos relinked meanwhile and files now in use are skipped) → {found: [{id, from, to, by: name|content}], missing, ambiguous: [{id, from, candidates}] (several same-name candidates and no hash to tell them apart: skipped)}.

tools.name: cmd_library_findSimilar
tools.description: Find Similar Photos (command `library.findSimilar`). Params: {id?, similarity?: 0..1 (0.8), filter?: bool (true)} — photos that look like the active one (composition and tones), most similar first; filters the view to them (Clear Filters to go back) → {photos: [{id, similarity}]}. Menu: Photo.

tools.name: cmd_library_folders
tools.description: Library Folders (command `library.folders`). Params: {} → [{name, path, count, own, volume, selectable, label?, children}] the disks and the folders the library's photos were imported from, with photo counts (subfolders included in `count`); show one with library.source {kind: libraryFolder, path} (rows with selectable false only open).

tools.name: cmd_library_forgetLocal
tools.description: Forget Unchanged Local Photos (command `library.forgetLocal`). Params: {dryRun?: bool, days?: n (default: the library preference, 0 = never)} — remove Local (browsed, not added) photos nobody changed, of folders not browsed for `days`, from the catalog; files and sidecars stay, browsing the folder again brings them back; not an undo step → {local, forgotten, keptRecent, keptTouched, keptInUse, foldersStamped, days, dryRun}.

tools.name: cmd_library_groups
tools.description: Date Groups (command `library.groups`). Params: {by?: day|month|year (default: the sort's grouping; auto = day)} → [{key, label, start, count}] date headers of the grid.

tools.name: cmd_library_holdView
tools.description: Hold View Until Refreshed (command `library.holdView`). Params: {on?: bool (toggles when omitted)} → {hold} — when on, an edit that makes a photo stop matching the view (a keyword given in a smart album of photos without keywords, a flag taken off in Picks, a rating under the filter bar's) keeps it in the view until `library.refresh`, Reshuffle, or another source, filter or sort; photos that start matching still appear at once, and deleting a photo or taking it out of the album or folder shown still takes it out of the view. Changing a smart album's rules is another view too. Off (the default): the view follows every edit. Kept with the library's preferences; asking for the state it already has changes nothing. Menu: View.

tools.name: cmd_library_import
tools.description: Import Photos (command `library.import`). Params: {paths: [file or folder (recursive)], mode?: add|copy|move (add = reference the files in place; copy = into the library's Originals/YYYY/YYYY-MM-DD/; move = as copy, then each original and its XMP sidecars are removed from the source — only after the copy is verified (a hard link on the same volume, else copied, synced and compared byte for byte) and its catalog record is saved; failed, duplicate and unchecked files keep their sources; a taken name gets -1, -2…; undo removes the photos from the library but leaves the files at the destination), destination?: folder for copies / moves, organize?: date (YYYY/YYYY-MM-DD) | month (YYYY/YYYY-MM) | flat | a folder template, e.g. `{date:%Y}/{date:%Y%m%d}` → 2026/20260114 (the template's `/` make the folders, each level expanded with the rename tokens and made a safe folder name: never outside the destination; must be relative, no `..`; a level with missing metadata is `unknown`) — dated by capture time, else the import time, rename?: file-name template for copies, original extension added (tokens: {name} {num} {seq} {seq:N} {date} {date:%Y%m%d} {folder} {camera} {lens} {iso} {rating} {title} {creator} {ext}; photo.renameTokens explains each; blank = keep names), renameStart?: 1 (must fit this platform; later files are reported failed if the sequence runs out), metadataPreset?: name, dng?: bool (copy raws as DNG; copy only), local?: bool (browsing: the photos stay out of the library, like library.browse; not with move), album?: albumId, albumName?: new album, preset?: presetId, keywords?: [..], onDeleted?: restore|skip|fresh (a file that is in Recently Deleted: restore (default) = bring the photo back with its edits — relinked to the file when its own is gone, skip = leave it there and say so, fresh = delete the trashed record and import the file as new)} → {imported, duplicates: [{path, existing, reason, existingDeleted?}], restored?: [photoId], failed, warnings?: [{path, code: cameraProfile|uprightGeometry|unmappedXmp, profile?, mode?: off|auto|level|vertical|full|guided|unknown, fields?}], moved?: [{from, to, sidecars?}], kept?: [{path, reason}] (move: sources left in place and why), album?}. Menu: File. Shortcut: Cmd+Shift+I.

tools.name: cmd_library_importLightroom
tools.description: Import Lightroom Catalog (command `library.importLightroom`). Params: {path: .lrcat, updateExisting?: false}; direct import of paths, ratings, flags, metadata, keywords, collections, virtual copies & mapped edits. Archives source settings/history first. Existing edited photos are preserved unless updateExisting=true; source catalog is read-only..

tools.name: cmd_library_importPreview
tools.description: Review Import (command `library.importPreview`). Params: {paths: [file or folder (recursive)]} → {candidates: [{path, name, format, kind, width, height, fileSize, captured, duplicate?: path|content, existing?, error?, previewOnly?: why a raw can only be shown from its embedded preview}], duplicates, scanned} — nothing is added.

tools.name: cmd_library_info
tools.description: Library Info (command `library.info`). Params: {}.

tools.name: cmd_library_inspectLightroom
tools.description: Inspect Lightroom Catalog (command `library.inspectLightroom`). Params: {path: .lrcat} → {photos, collections, missing, warnings}; read-only, no Lightroom required.

tools.name: cmd_library_memory
tools.description: Memory Usage (command `library.memory`). Params: {} — bytes held by each cache (decoded sources, rendered previews, GPU buffers; heap when instrumented).

tools.name: cmd_library_missing
tools.description: Missing Photos (command `library.missing`). Params: {} → [{id, path}] — photos whose original file isn't where the library expects it (every file is looked at: on a network share that takes minutes, so the desktop app, asked over its control channel, checks on a worker thread, with a row in the activity stack that can stop it, and answers when it is done).

tools.name: cmd_library_next
tools.description: Next Photo (command `library.next`). Params: {}. Shortcut: Right.

tools.name: cmd_library_preferences
tools.description: Library Preferences (command `library.preferences`). Params: {import?: {rawPreset?: presetId|"default", otherPreset?: presetId|"default", perCamera?: bool, cameras?: [{camera: "Make Model", preset: presetId|null}], copyright?: text, creator?: text (given to imported photos without one), showOnCard?: bool (open the import review when a camera or card is connected)}, camera?: {camera, preset?, remove?: bool}, cacheMb?: n (0 = default), forgetLocalDays?: n (forget untouched Local photos of folders not browsed for n days; 0 = never)} — develop defaults applied on import (raws / other images / per camera) and the thumbnail cache size, saved with the library → {xmp, import, cacheMb, forgetLocalDays, persistent}.

tools.name: cmd_library_previewProgress
tools.description: Preview Build Progress (command `library.previewProgress`). Params: {} → {total, done, failed, repaired, running, cancelled, what, error} | null.

tools.name: cmd_library_previous
tools.description: Previous Photo (command `library.previous`). Params: {}. Shortcut: Left.

tools.name: cmd_library_recheckPreviewOnly
tools.description: Recheck Preview-Only Raws (command `library.recheckPreviewOnly`). Params: {all?: bool} — probe again the raws shown from their embedded preview whose flag another LightCraft version set (the app does this in the background when a library opens; `all` rechecks every preview-only raw, e.g. when testing a decoder build of the same version), and bring each up to date as Reload from Disk would; not an undo step, develop settings and history are kept; files that can't be read are left for next time → {checked, updated: [ids], cleared: [ids] (develop from their raw data now)}.

tools.name: cmd_library_refresh
tools.description: Refresh View (command `library.refresh`). Params: {} — show what matches now: a view that holds its photos (`library.holdView`) lets go of the ones that stopped matching a smart album's rules, Picks or the filter bar since it was opened, sorted or last refreshed. Menu: View.

tools.name: cmd_library_refreshLensProfiles
tools.description: Look Up Lens Profiles Again (command `library.refreshLensProfiles`). Params: {ids?: [photo ids], all?: bool} — library raws without a lens profile whose lens the lens database knows are read again and get their profile (the correction is switched on where the photo's settings are still as imported); with all, also raws whose profile came from the database (it may give another, or none) and raws whose file named no lens at import; the app does this by itself when the database arrives (all: when its files were replaced) and when Enable Lens Corrections is ticked; not an undo step → {checked, found: [ids], database: bool}.

tools.name: cmd_library_removeFolder
tools.description: Remove Folder from Library (command `library.removeFolder`). Params: {path, disk?: bool} — move the library photos imported from this folder (and the folders inside it) to Recently Deleted; one undo step, no file is touched. A whole disk or share (`/Volumes/nas`, `C:\`, `\\srv\share`) goes only with `disk: true`, the startup disk never → {removed}.

tools.name: cmd_library_retrySidecars
tools.description: Write Waiting XMP Sidecars (command `library.retrySidecars`). Params: {} — writes again the automatic XMP sidecars that failed (folder offline, read-only or full) whose originals are reachable now → {written, waiting}.

tools.name: cmd_library_select
tools.description: Select Photos (command `library.select`). Params: {ids: [id], active?: id, mode?: replace|add|toggle|range} — every id must be a photo of the library.

tools.name: cmd_library_selectAll
tools.description: Select All (command `library.selectAll`). Params: {}. Menu: Edit. Shortcut: Cmd+A.

tools.name: cmd_library_selectBy
tools.description: Select by Flag, Rating or Label (command `library.selectBy`). Params: {flag?: pick|reject|none, rating?: 0..5, ratingOp?: gte|eq|lte (default gte), label?: red|…|none, add?: bool (extend the selection)} — among the photos in view.

tools.name: cmd_library_selectNone
tools.description: Deselect All (command `library.selectNone`). Params: {}. Menu: Edit. Shortcut: Cmd+Shift+A.

tools.name: cmd_library_shuffle
tools.description: Reshuffle (command `library.shuffle`). Params: {seed?: 0..2^53-1} — sort at random; without `seed` a new shuffle each time. Menu: View › Sort.

tools.name: cmd_library_smartPreviews
tools.description: Build Smart Previews (command `library.smartPreviews`). Params: {ids?, discard?: bool, background?: bool} — build (or discard) the smart previews of the selected photos (else all in view): compact proxies in the library that keep photos editable and exportable (at proxy size) while their originals are offline; a damaged proxy (cut short) is rebuilt → {built, repaired, removed, failed}; with background (the app's menu) the files are read and written on a worker thread → {total, done, failed, repaired, running, what} like library.buildPreviews (progress: library.previewProgress, stop: library.cancelPreviews).

tools.name: cmd_library_smartPreviewsLocation
tools.description: Smart Previews Location (command `library.smartPreviewsLocation`). Params: {path?: absolute folder, reset?: bool, existing?: move|leave|discard} — without path/reset: where this library keeps its smart previews → {path, default, custom, available, count, bytes}. With path (or reset = back to `Smart Previews` in the library): use that folder instead (must exist or have an existing parent, and accept writes; never falls back to another drive). Smart previews already in the old folder need `existing`: move them, leave them (build again), or discard them → also {handled, failed}.

tools.name: cmd_library_sort
tools.description: Sort (command `library.sort`). Params: {key?: captureDate|importDate|editDate|fileName|rating|fileSize|random, ascending?: bool, group?: auto|none|day|month|year, seed?: u64 (the shuffle `random` gives)}. Menu: View › Sort.

tools.name: cmd_library_source
tools.description: Show Source (command `library.source`). Params: {kind: all|recentlyAdded|album|recentlyDeleted|picks|missing|libraryFolder, id?: albumId, path?: a path from library.folders (for libraryFolder)}.

tools.name: cmd_library_state
tools.description: Library State (command `library.state`). Params: {}.

tools.name: cmd_library_toggleAutoWriteXmp
tools.description: Automatically Write Changes into XMP (command `library.toggleAutoWriteXmp`). Params: {} → {autoWrite}. Menu: File.

tools.name: cmd_library_toggleFilters
tools.description: Enable Filters (command `library.toggleFilters`). Params: {} — with a filter set, puts it aside and shows everything; with one put aside, brings it back as it was (stars, flag, text… together). Setting or clearing a filter while it is off forgets the one put aside → {enabled, count}. Menu: View. Shortcut: Cmd+L.

tools.name: cmd_library_up
tools.description: Photo Above (command `library.up`). Params: {rows?: n (photos to move back; default 1, the grid passes the distance to the cell above)}. Shortcut: Up.

tools.name: cmd_library_xmpPreferences
tools.description: XMP Sidecar Preferences (command `library.xmpPreferences`). Params: {autoWrite?: bool, naming?: stem (IMG_1.xmp, default) | full (IMG_1.CR3.xmp)} → current preferences (saved with the library).

tools.name: cmd_mask_add
tools.description: Create New Mask (command `mask.add`). Params: {kind: brush|linear|radial|sky|subject|background|luminanceRange|colorRange|object|prompt, ...shape params (start/end, center/rx/ry/angle/feather, lo/hi…; object: points/exclude [[x,y],…]; prompt: text; object/prompt: seg? a stored segmentation, no model needed), name?} — AI kinds need the SAM 3 model; in the app a prompt returns {pending} and the mask appears when found.

tools.name: cmd_mask_addComponent
tools.description: Add/Subtract/Intersect Mask (command `mask.addComponent`). Params: {id?: maskId, op: add|subtract|intersect, kind, ...shape params}.

tools.name: cmd_mask_adjust
tools.description: Set Mask Adjustments (command `mask.adjust`). Params: {id?, values: {exposure, contrast, highlights, shadows, whites, blacks, temp, tint, texture, clarity, dehaze, hue, saturation, sharpness, noise, moire, defringe, color_hue, color_sat, amount}}.

tools.name: cmd_mask_applyEffect
tools.description: Apply Mask Effect (command `mask.applyEffect`). Params: {name, id? | ids?: [maskId] | all?: bool, photos?: "selected" (also the masks of the same names on the other selected photos, one undo step), remember?: bool (true: new masks of this kind start with it)} — sets the effect's sliders (all, or the ones it keeps; Amount only if it carries it) → {name, masks, photos, brush}.

tools.name: cmd_mask_brushStroke
tools.description: Brush Stroke (command `mask.brushStroke`). Params: {id?: maskId, points: [[x,y],…] normalized, size?: fraction of long edge (0.03), feather?, flow?, density?, erase?: bool, autoMask?: bool, pressure?: [p,…] pen pressure 0..1 per point (scales each dab's size and flow; omitted: full), connect?: bool — start from the last point of the mask's last stroke (⇧-click), size / feather / flow tapering from that stroke's to these} → {activeMask, connected}.

tools.name: cmd_mask_component
tools.description: Edit Mask Component (command `mask.component`). Params: {id?, component: index, action: invert|duplicate|delete|rename|op, name? (rename; empty clears), op?: add|subtract|intersect} — one component of a mask (deleting the last one deletes the mask).

tools.name: cmd_mask_delete
tools.description: Delete Mask (command `mask.delete`). Params: {id?}.

tools.name: cmd_mask_deleteAll
tools.description: Delete All Masks (command `mask.deleteAll`). Params: {}.

tools.name: cmd_mask_deleteEffect
tools.description: Delete Mask Effect (command `mask.deleteEffect`). Params: {name | names: [name]} — removes effect presets.

tools.name: cmd_mask_duplicate
tools.description: Duplicate Mask (command `mask.duplicate`). Params: {id?, invert?: bool (Duplicate and Invert)} — the copy goes right after the original and is selected.

tools.name: cmd_mask_duplicateEffect
tools.description: Duplicate Mask Effect (command `mask.duplicateEffect`). Params: {name, to?} (default "<name> copy") → list + {name}.

tools.name: cmd_mask_effects
tools.description: Mask Effect Presets (command `mask.effects`). Params: {} → {effects: [{name, adjust, group?, favorite?, fields?, with_amount?, brush?, extra?}], groups: [{name, effects: [name]}] (menu order), current: the effect the selected mask matches or null, toolEffects: {tool: effect a new mask of that kind starts with}}.

tools.name: cmd_mask_exportEffects
tools.description: Export Mask Effects (command `mask.exportEffects`). Params: {path, names?: [name], group?: name (default: all)} — writes an .lceffect JSON file (groups, stars and kept Lightroom settings included) → {path, count}.

tools.name: cmd_mask_favoriteEffect
tools.description: Favorite Mask Effect (command `mask.favoriteEffect`). Params: {name | names, favorite?: bool (default: toggle)}.

tools.name: cmd_mask_importEffects
tools.description: Import Mask Effects (command `mask.importEffects`). Params: {path | paths: [file or folder], group?, dryRun?} — Lightroom Classic local adjustment presets (.lrtemplate), Camera Raw local correction presets (.xmp), .lceffect files and .zip bundles of these; folders and Lightroom's divider presets ("10 ----- DETAIL ----- 10") become groups; same-named effects are replaced → {imported: [{name, group, file, unmapped}], dividers: [{name, group, file}], failed: [[file, error]]}.

tools.name: cmd_mask_invert
tools.description: Invert Mask (command `mask.invert`). Params: {id?}.

tools.name: cmd_mask_move
tools.description: Move Mask (command `mask.move`). Params: {id?, to?: index (0 = top), delta?: ±n} — reorder the masks list.

tools.name: cmd_mask_objectPoint
tools.description: Add Object Click (command `mask.objectPoint`). Params: {x, y: normalized image point, exclude?: bool (⌥-click: leave this part out), id?: maskId} — a click on the selected mask's Object selection (its last Object component); SAM 3 re-segments the object → {include, exclude}.

tools.name: cmd_mask_refine
tools.description: Refine Mask Edges (command `mask.refine`). Params: {id?, value: 0..100} — the mask's edges snap to the photo's (guided filter; rendered on the CPU).

tools.name: cmd_mask_refineDetail
tools.description: Refine AI Mask Detail (command `mask.refineDetail`). Params: {id?: maskId, component?} — a zoomed-in SAM 3 pass over an Object/Describe selection (default: the mask's last one): the photo around it is analyzed again at a higher resolution, in the background; the mask updates when it's done → {started}.

tools.name: cmd_mask_rename
tools.description: Rename Mask (command `mask.rename`). Params: {id?, name}.

tools.name: cmd_mask_renameEffect
tools.description: Rename Mask Effect (command `mask.renameEffect`). Params: {name, to}.

tools.name: cmd_mask_renameEffectGroup
tools.description: Rename Mask Effect Group (command `mask.renameEffectGroup`). Params: {group, to} ("" ungroups; an existing name merges).

tools.name: cmd_mask_sampleColor
tools.description: Sample Mask Color (command `mask.sampleColor`). Params: {x, y: normalized image point, add?: bool (⇧: add to the samples, max 5), id?, component?} — the colour range of the selected mask (its first colour-range component) samples the colour there → {samples}.

tools.name: cmd_mask_saveEffect
tools.description: Save Mask Effect (command `mask.saveEffect`). Params: {name, id?, group?, fields?: "all" (default) | "changed" | [slider], amount?: bool (carry Amount), brush?: {size, feather, flow, density, auto_mask}} — the selected mask's sliders as an effect preset (replaces one of that name), saved with the library.

tools.name: cmd_mask_select
tools.description: Select Mask (command `mask.select`). Params: {id|null}.

tools.name: cmd_mask_setEffectGroup
tools.description: Move Mask Effect to Group (command `mask.setEffectGroup`). Params: {name | names, group: name ("" = none)}.

tools.name: cmd_mask_toolEffect
tools.description: Set Effect for New Masks (command `mask.toolEffect`). Params: {tool: brush|linear|radial|subject|…, name?} — the effect new masks of that kind start with (no name: none).

tools.name: cmd_mask_update
tools.description: Update Mask Shape (command `mask.update`). Params: {id?, component?: index (0), shape: MaskShape JSON}.

tools.name: cmd_mask_updateEffect
tools.description: Update Mask Effect (command `mask.updateEffect`). Params: {name, id?, fields?, amount?, brush?} — overwrite the effect with the selected mask's sliders (keeps its group, star and which sliders it carries unless given).

tools.name: cmd_mask_visible
tools.description: Show/Hide Mask (command `mask.visible`). Params: {id?, visible?: bool}.

tools.name: cmd_merge_hdr
tools.description: HDR Merge (command `merge.hdr`). Params: {ids?, align=true, deghost=none|low|medium|high, autoSettings=true, stack=false, preview=false, showOverlay=false, previewPath?}.

tools.name: cmd_merge_hdrBatch
tools.description: HDR for Each Bracket Set (command `merge.hdrBatch`). Params: {ids?, align=true, deghost=none|low|medium|high, autoSettings=true, stack=false}: an HDR merge of each bracket set among the photos (each stack, then photos taken less than a second apart at exposures ≥ ½ EV apart) → {merged: [{id, path, …}], failed: [{photos, error}]}. Menu: Photo › Photo Merge.

tools.name: cmd_merge_hdrPanorama
tools.description: HDR Panorama Merge (command `merge.hdrPanorama`). Params: {ids?, bracket=0 (auto from EXIF), align, deghost, projection, boundaryWarp, autoCrop, fillEdges, autoSettings, stack, preview, previewPath?}.

tools.name: cmd_merge_panorama
tools.description: Panorama Merge (command `merge.panorama`). Params: {ids?, projection=auto|spherical|cylindrical|perspective, boundaryWarp=0..100, autoCrop=false, fillEdges=false, autoSettings=true, stack=false, maxMegapixels=full size (≤ 512, held to memory), preview=false, previewPath?}.

tools.name: cmd_metadata_applyPreset
tools.description: Apply Metadata Preset (command `metadata.applyPreset`). Params: {name, ids?} — text fields replace, keywords are added; one undo step.

tools.name: cmd_metadata_deletePreset
tools.description: Delete Metadata Preset (command `metadata.deletePreset`). Params: {name}.

tools.name: cmd_metadata_downloadPlaceNames
tools.description: Download Place Names (GeoNames) (command `metadata.downloadPlaceNames`). Params: {dataset?: folder} → {started, path, attribution} — downloads the GeoNames cities list (CC-BY 4.0, ~3 MB, from download.geonames.org) in the background for Fill Location from GPS; no photo data is sent. Menu: Photo.

tools.name: cmd_metadata_placeNamesStatus
tools.description: Place Names Status (command `metadata.placeNamesStatus`). Params: {dataset?: folder} → {downloaded, bytes, path, attribution, source}.

tools.name: cmd_metadata_presets
tools.description: Metadata Presets (command `metadata.presets`). Params: {} → [{name, fields}].

tools.name: cmd_metadata_reverseGeocode
tools.description: Fill Location from GPS (command `metadata.reverseGeocode`). Params: {ids?, overwrite?: bool (also replace place fields that already have text; default false: only empty ones are filled), dryRun?, dataset?: folder, maxDistance?: metres (past this distance from the town found, City is left empty and the town is given as nearestCity)} → {looked, found, changed, photos: [{id, place: {sublocation, city, state, country, iso, distance}, nearestCity?}], attribution} — fills City / State / Country (and Sublocation when known) from GPS with the offline GeoNames place names (download them first); one undo step. The place names list towns of 15 000 people or more (GeoNames cities15000): a photo taken in a smaller town gets the nearest larger one, up to 50 km away (`distance` says how far); `maxDistance` keeps such a town out of City. Menu: Photo.

tools.name: cmd_metadata_savePreset
tools.description: Save Metadata Preset (command `metadata.savePreset`). Params: {name, fields?: {copyright?, copyrightStatus?: unknown|copyrighted|publicDomain, usageTerms?, copyrightUrl?, creator?, title?, caption?, location?, city?, state?, country?, keywords?: [..]}, only?: [field] (from the active photo when `fields` is absent; default the copyright fields, creator, place)} — adds or replaces.

tools.name: cmd_photo_addToLibrary
tools.description: Add to My Photos (command `photo.addToLibrary`). Params: {ids?} — browsed (Local) photos join the library. Menu: Photo.

tools.name: cmd_photo_allMetadata
tools.description: All Metadata (command `photo.allMetadata`). Params: {id?} → {exif: [{group, tag, name, value}], xmp: [{name, value}]} — every EXIF / TIFF / GPS tag of the file and its XMP properties.

tools.name: cmd_photo_analyze
tools.description: Assisted Culling (command `photo.analyze`). Params: {ids?, rejectBelow?: sharpness 0..100, pickBest?: bool, burstGap?: seconds 0..86400 (10), similarity?: 0..1 (0.93)} — score the selected photos (else all in view) for focus (0..100) and clipping, group look-alike shots (signature similarity at least `similarity`) taken at most `burstGap` seconds apart and mark the sharpest of each; optionally reject blurry photos and pick each group's best; one undo step → {photos: [{id, sharpness, clipped, group, best}], groups, rejected, picked}.

tools.name: cmd_photo_autoTagTracklog
tools.description: Auto-Tag Photos from Tracklog (command `photo.autoTagTracklog`). Params: {path?: GPX file | gpx?: GPX text, ids?, offset?: camera clock's UTC offset for photos whose capture time has no zone (`+02:00`, or hours; default UTC), maxGap?: seconds (600), replace?: bool (also photos that already have GPS), dryRun?: bool} → {tagged, interpolated, nearest, skipped: {noTime, outside, hasGps}, assumedUtc, points, start, end, photos: [{id, gps, match}]} — positions from the track log by capture time; one undo step.

tools.name: cmd_photo_clearLabel
tools.description: Clear Color Label (command `photo.clearLabel`). Params: {ids?, advance?: bool} — `photo.label` with `none`; without `ids`, the selection moves on when this takes the active photo out of the view. Menu: Photo › Set Color Label.

tools.name: cmd_photo_convertToDng
tools.description: Convert to DNG (command `photo.convertToDng`). Params: {ids?} — write each raw photo as a lossless DNG next to it (settings embedded) and relink the photo to it; originals are kept → {converted: [{id, path, original}], skipped}. Menu: Photo.

tools.name: cmd_photo_copyMetadata
tools.description: Copy Metadata (command `photo.copyMetadata`). Params: {} — title, caption, copyright (notice, status, usage terms, info URL), creator, location and keywords of the active photo. Menu: Photo. Shortcut: Cmd+Alt+Shift+C.

tools.name: cmd_photo_cycleFlag
tools.description: Cycle Flag (command `photo.cycleFlag`). Params: {ids?, advance?: bool} — each photo's own flag: unflagged -> pick -> reject -> unflagged; without `ids`, the selection moves on when this takes the active photo out of the view. Menu: Photo › Set Flag. Shortcut: `.

tools.name: cmd_photo_decreaseFlag
tools.description: Decrease Flag Status (command `photo.decreaseFlag`). Params: {ids?, advance?: bool} — pick -> unflagged -> reject (stops at reject); without `ids`, the selection moves on when this takes the active photo out of the view. Menu: Photo › Set Flag. Shortcut: Cmd+Down.

tools.name: cmd_photo_decreaseRating
tools.description: Decrease Rating (command `photo.decreaseRating`). Params: {ids?, advance?: bool} — without `ids`, the selection moves on when this takes the active photo out of the view.

tools.name: cmd_photo_delete
tools.description: Delete Photo (command `photo.delete`). Params: {ids?} — moves to Recently Deleted. Menu: Photo. Shortcut: Delete.

tools.name: cmd_photo_deletePermanently
tools.description: Delete Permanently (command `photo.deletePermanently`). Params: {ids?}. Menu: Photo.

tools.name: cmd_photo_duplicate
tools.description: Duplicate (command `photo.duplicate`). Params: {ids?} — copy each photo's file next to it (`-copy`) and add it with the same settings, metadata and albums (a real file, unlike a virtual copy) → {ids}. Menu: Photo.

tools.name: cmd_photo_editExternal
tools.description: Edit Copy for External Editor (command `photo.editExternal`).
